dimensions.name: Press Release Traceability
dimensions.pass_criteria: A stakeholder who has read the Press Release can use the demo and immediately recognize the product. The core customer, problem, and solution are visible in the app.
dimensions.fail_criteria: The demo looks generic. The specific customer persona, problem, or benefit from the Press Release is not evident.

dimensions.name: Core User Journey Coverage
dimensions.pass_criteria: The demo implements the primary user journey end-to-end: entry point, core action, and outcome.
dimensions.fail_criteria: The demo shows isolated screens or stops before the user reaches the outcome described in the Press Release.

dimensions.name: Structural Runnability
dimensions.pass_criteria: All imported components, modules, and files exist. npm dependencies are real packages. Vite config and package scripts are syntactically correct.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Imports reference missing files, dependencies are fabricated or misspelled, scripts are malformed, or syntax errors would prevent loading.

dimensions.name: Mock Data Honesty
dimensions.pass_criteria: All data shown is clearly mock data or labelled as demo data. The demo does not imply real backend integration it does not have.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Mock data is presented in a way that could mislead stakeholders about what is actually built.
